additional_info.subject: 0368385 - ID0368385-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170000897] Isolation Issue CRM:00658000650
additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Bastien Bonhomme,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Saurav
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P8 170000897
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
TJeDP0
Problem Description
: Isolation Fault
Troubleshooting
: Logs analyzed.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0368385
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We have checked the logs for the time frame you mentioned and found that Isolation test was not initialized, which failed the charging session.
In the last one month we have observed this issue on this outlet 4 times.
Can you confirm whether there was any successful charging session on outlet 1 (ChaDeMo) on this charger is last 1 month?
If not then we will proceed for on site intervention to resolve this issue.
Awaiting your response.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav Kumar
